fact: The Maroc Telecom West Africa cable's southern segment from Casablanca and Dakhla was put in service in July 2021 at 20 Tbps, and its northern segment from Casablanca to Lisbon has been operational since April 2022 at 60 Tbps.
title: Fibre optique : Maroc Telecom déploie « West Africa » pour améliorer la connectivité en Afrique
